creation_before_handoff.method: build handoff from complete sequence evidence and host anchor after sequence completion

after_handoff_before_preview.method: new Cycle20 process independently verifies and replays the same bundle

after_preview_before_commit.method: restart reconstructs baseline; preview transaction IDs are process-local and not reusable

workflow_atomicity: Each creation and the multi-target maintenance batch are atomic individually; the complete handoff workflow is not atomic.
